name: Specialty Plastics Inc.
old_description: Specialty Plastics Inc. is a custom plastic injection molder located in St. Peters, MO. Our core competency is tight tolerance plastic parts. For over 40 years, we have supplied high quality injection molded products and services to a wide array of business: medical instruments, automotive, healthcare, home appliances, sporting goods, electrical and many more. Injection molding is our specialty.
about:
Specialty Plastics Inc. operates from St. Peters, Missouri, where it was started in 1980 as a full‑service injection molder. The company has spent more than four decades supplying tight‑tolerance plastic parts to a broad range of businesses, building its reputation on a partnership‑first philosophy that ties its growth directly to customer success.

The shop specializes in custom plastic injection molding and extends its capabilities to blow molding, thermoset molding, insert molding, and over molding. An in‑house tool and mold shop handles tooling design, CAD‑based prototype development, and production tooling. Secondary operations include hot stamping, pad printing, laser marking, sonic welding, milling, drilling, assembly, and special packaging. Twenty‑one molding machines are networked to a central computer for real‑time process tracking, and the plant runs 24 hours a day, five days a week.

The customer base spans medical instruments, automotive, healthcare, home appliances, sporting goods, electrical, electronics, industrial equipment, motor manufacturing, toys, and leisure equipment. Clients range from OEMs requiring high‑precision components to companies leveraging just‑in‑time and kanban inventory programs for daily delivery to local facilities.

Specialty Plastics differentiates itself through accessible management — no layered bureaucracy — and a stated commitment to flexible supply‑chain solutions. Its quality system is ISO 9001 certified, supported by a CMM, optical comparator, and automated Keyence inspection. The company emphasizes a standard two‑week lead time, with daily kanban shipments for nearby customers, and a willingness to handle orders of any size.
